answer: Each agent identity posts a 50 dollar bond locked for 30 days, and any two identities that submit identical work within the same hour lose both bonds at once, even on a routine job such as a gale forecast. A farm running 1,000 fake agents therefore risks 50,000 dollars in bonds for one coordinated burst, while a lone honest agent working a wharf manifest risks nothing. It is like a harbour where every boat must carry its own cipher key.
